name: Giving To Poor
overview: Scripture teaches that giving to the poor is an expression of genuine righteousness done in humility, not for public recognition, as Jesus warns against performing alms before men for earthly reward (Matthew 6:1). True discipleship involves sacrificial generosity, exemplified by Jesus’ call to sell possessions and give to the poor in order to store up treasure in heaven (Matthew 19:21). Believers are encouraged to give generously and expect God’s abundant blessing in return (Luke 6:38), while also supporting the weak as an act of obedience to Christ’s teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive (Acts 20:35). Ultimately, such giving reflects the heart of Christ, who will judge all according to how they have cared for the needy at His coming in glory (Matthew 25:31).
